---
name: Bug report
about: Tell us something that went wrong
title: '[bug] '
labels: bug
---

## What happened?

A one-sentence summary of the problem.

## What were you doing?

The steps you took, in order. Reproduction matters more than the
exact wording.

## What did you expect?

What you thought would happen. "I expected this to work" is
fine; "I expected this to work and it printed X" is better.

## Kingfisher version

From Help → About (or the `Settings → Diagnostics` panel). The
"Copy support information" button captures it.

## Where

- [ ] Web
- [ ] macOS desktop

## Operating system

macOS / Windows / Linux and the version (e.g. macOS 14.5).

## Support information

Paste the _Copy support information_ line from
`Settings → Diagnostics`. It is short and contains no
personal data.

For a deeper problem, attach the _full diagnostic report_ (also from
that panel) — URL credentials, query strings and home-directory
names are redacted at write time.

If the report contains a PGN, a study, or a private note, **do not
paste it here** — attach a file instead, and tell us what to
expect when we open it.
